source: Game Concept/narrative/FINAL_SCRIPT.md, SC05 and its encounter notes. Lines marked "system": true are gameplay feedback, hints or placeholder prompts that are not in the script; review them before release.

arrive.text: A short route under intense sun. Tavo recognises cooler stone, shade and usable wind.

ambush.text: Beside the broken way station, a husk drags itself upright: an abandoned maintenance shell, still moving.
When it glows, it is winding up. Strike it then to interrupt, or dodge the blow.
After it strikes, its copper connector is exposed. Hit the connector with your repair hammer.

second.text: A second husk comes up the road.

defeat.text: Tavo stumbles back to the edge of the road. Catch your breath and try again.

merchant.text: A merchant hides behind his cart.

merchant.speaker: MERCHANT
merchant.text: I shouted that I owned the road. They stopped.

merchant_after.speaker: MERCHANT
merchant_after.text: I'll stay with the cart. The road can have its quiet back.

inspect_way_station.text: A carved hand on one side; a shallow bowl on the other.

inspect_way_station.speaker: TAVO
inspect_way_station.text: The bowl is polished by use. The hand was gilded later.

nali.text: Nali is treating a traveller nearby. She has followed the same route to bring medicine to the fortress survivors.

nali.speaker: NALI
nali.text: You've got blood on your sleeve.

nali.speaker: NALI
nali.text: Then someone else needs the cloth.
She gives him a clean strip and takes the stained one for washing. They continue together.

nali_after.speaker: NALI
nali_after.text: Reed Gate is ahead. Keep to the shade.

exit_husks.text: Not with husks on the road.

exit_help_first.text: Someone by the road is treating a wounded traveller.
